description: This file contains macro definitions, structure declarations, and prototypes related to a memory management system called 'commit slabs'. It defines data structures and helper macros to initialize, clear, and access memory slabs used in a commit-based system.

methods.name: init_<slabname>_with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a commit slab with a specified stride.

methods.name: init_<slabname>
methods.description: Initializes a commit slab with default parameters.

methods.name: clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Clears the commit slab, freeing its resources.

methods.name: deep_clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Deep clears the commit slab, freeing its resources using a custom free function.

methods.name: <slabname>_at_peek
methods.description: Returns an element at a specific position in the slab, possibly adding it if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_at
methods.description: Returns an element at a specific position in the slab.

methods.name: <slabname>_peek
methods.description: Returns the next element in the slab, possibly adding it.
